target_customer: Middle income Indian savers who buy gold
problem: Indians love gold but buying it requires lump sums, store visits and storage; most savers use low return bank deposits.
business_model: Upfront margin per transaction on digital gold bought via UPI Autopay, plus jeweller partnerships

founders.name: Dilip Jain
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built BHIM, an early UPI app, early in his career; employer not named there. Press describes the founders as former Juspay executives.

founders.name: Manthan Shah
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built Visa Safe Click, a one-click card authentication product in India.

founders.name: Naimisha Rao
founders.background_notes: Growth work for 40+ brands per YC page.

competitors.name: Jar
competitors.what: Micro-savings app investing small amounts into digital gold
competitors.funding_then: 32M Series A led by Tiger Global in Feb 2022 after 4.5M earlier round

competitors.name: OroPocket
competitors.what: Digital gold micro-investment app named as operating in the same segment

competitors.name: Spare8
competitors.what: Digital gold micro-investment app named as operating in the same segment

technical_complexity.rationale: Integrates UPI Autopay with a gold supplier (Augmont) and vault custody; mostly standard fintech engineering with partner APIs.

defensibility.rationale: Gold supply and payments come from partners, so copying is easy; jeweller partnerships and user base later add some stickiness.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Payment apps already sold digital gold; no source shows them killing Gullak, which raised a Series A in 2025.

market_need_then: The company cites 200 million Indians saving manually in bank deposits, about 30B dollars of gold bought yearly by middle income households, and fast early uptake (40k transacting users in 60 days per the YC profile).

branding.name_origin: Gullak is the Hindi word for a piggy bank; the company site does not state the link itself, so this is inferred from the word's meaning.
branding.domain_note: Uses gullak.money, a .money TLD rather than .com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Warm and cultural; tagline Make every day a good day to buy gold

branding.brand_signature: Tagline Make every day a good day to buy gold
branding.community_and_virality: Partnerships with jewellers such as Tanishq, BlueStone and Malabar listed on the site; the 2025 raise was partly framed as strengthening the brand.

brand_strength.rationale: A culturally resonant Hindi word for savings fits the product, but no independent press about the brand itself was found.

outcome_analysis: Gullak launched in India with fast early growth in automated gold savings, then raised a pre-seed in 2022, a seed in 2023 and a Series A in 2025 from Better Capital, Stellaris, YC, Chiratae and others. Founders with UPI and payments product experience fit the problem, and the company is still operating. The main risks are that gold and payments are supplied by partners and that Jar and payment apps compete in the same segment.
notes: Pre-seed reported as INR 10 crore (Entrackr, Entrepreneur India) and about 1.3M dollars (YourStory). Total raised reported around 12M after Series A; one aggregator says 14.6M, not used. Founder education not found. Entity is Finterscale Technology Pvt Ltd per site.
